xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4310: Herdr terminal stream decodes UTF-8 bytes as Latin-1: mojibake in the dashboard Terminal tab

plan.title: Herdr terminal stream decodes UTF-8 bytes as Latin-1: mojibake in the dashboard Terminal tab
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: decodeTerminalRecord() in src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-stream.ts (lines 65-67) decodes each Herdr terminal.frame's base64 bytes with Buffer#toString('binary') (Latin-1). The string flows unchanged through HerdrTerminalProcess.pump() in src/dashboard/server/services/terminal-service.ts to the /ws/terminal client, so every non-ASCII character (e.g. U+25CF, UTF-8 E2 97 8F) renders as mojibake in the dashboard Terminal tab on the Herdr backend. Introduced in 48c0c6ce2d9 (PAN-3917 W8). The tmux path already decodes UTF-8.
narratives.Proposal: Decode frame bytes as UTF-8 with a streaming TextDecoder held as an optional decoder field on the per-stream TerminalDecodeState (created lazily). A full (snapshot) frame assigns a fresh decoder before decoding. Incremental frames that decode to the empty string emit no output frame. The record.text branch is unchanged. Add unit tests for split characters, snapshot reset, multi-byte/emoji, and per-stream decoder isolation, and document the UTF-8 decoding contract in the Herdr wire facts section of docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the tmux / node-pty / Bun PTY terminal path
- No change to the TerminalFrame type, terminal-service.ts, the /ws/terminal protocol, or the frontend
- No flush of a dangling partial UTF-8 sequence at stream end
- No change to the record.text branch or its interaction with pending decoder bytes
- No change to the control direction (terminal.input keeps sending text)
- No branching on the record's encoding field ('ansi' names escape sequences, not a charset)

autoDecisions.summary: Hold the decoder as an optional `decoder?: TextDecoder` field on TerminalDecodeState, created lazily with ??=.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps existing `{ cols, rows }` test literals and startStream's state initializer valid, so pre-existing tests pass unchanged; the state object is already per stream.

autoDecisions.summary: Use the global TextDecoder rather than string_decoder.StringDecoder.
autoDecisions.rationale: TextDecoder is already used under src/lib (deacon-event-client.ts, conversation-message.ts) and by BunPtyProcess in terminal-service.ts; StringDecoder is the stated fallback if typecheck rejects it.

autoDecisions.summary: Suppress output frames whose decoded data is empty; always emit snapshots.
autoDecisions.rationale: In-repo precedent BunPtyProcess.emitData drops empty text; an empty snapshot is a real blank-screen render.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not flush the decoder at stream end.
autoDecisions.rationale: A dangling partial would flush only to one U+FFFD, and the EOF path never passes through decodeTerminalRecord; plumbing it adds complexity for no visible value.

autoDecisions.summary: Invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD (non-fatal decoder) and never throws.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing rule in startStream that a corrupt line must not tear down a live terminal.

items.title: Decode Herdr terminal frame bytes as streaming UTF-8

expected_outputs: herdr-stream.test.ts passes, including the new split-character, snapshot-reset, multi-byte/emoji, and per-stream-decoder tests

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-stream.ts: add optional `decoder?: TextDecoder` to TerminalDecodeState; add a `decodeFrameData(record, state)` helper that returns record.text ?? '' when bytes is undefined, else `(state.decoder ??= new TextDecoder('utf-8')).decode(Buffer.from(record.bytes, 'base64'), { stream: true })`; in decodeTerminalRecord, for a full frame assign `state.decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8')` BEFORE decoding and always return the snapshot; for incremental frames keep the size-frame logic and push an output frame only when decoded data is non-empty. Remove the Buffer#toString('binary') call. Update the decodeTerminalRecord doc comment and add one line to the module header saying bytes is base64 UTF-8 and encoding 'ansi' is not a charset. Add the four tests listed in PRD WI-1 step 4 using explicit byte-array fixtures. Do not modify terminal-service.ts, types.ts, or the frontend. Do not change assertions of existing tests.

items.title: Given one decode state, when decodeTerminalRecord receives an incremental frame with bytes [E2] and then one with bytes [97 8F], then it returns [] for the first and [{kind:'output', data:'●'}] for the second

Given a decode state holding the partial byte E2, when a full frame with bytes 'hello' arrives, then it returns a snapshot whose data is exactly 'hello' (no leading U+FFFD), and a following frame [E2 97 8F] returns output '●'

Given two observeTerminal streams from the fake spawn, when stream 0 receives [E2] then [97 8F] and stream 1 receives only [97 8F], then stream 0 emits output '●' and stream 1 emits '\uFFFD\uFFFD', proving each stream has its own decoder

Given the Herdr backend and an agent pane showing Claude Code's UI, when the Terminal tab is opened in an isolated Playwright browser, then the xterm buffer renders '●', '─' and '⎿' and contains no 'â' or 'Â·' mojibake

When npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-stream.test.ts, npm run typecheck and npm run lint run, each exits 0 and the pre-existing herdr-stream tests pass with their assertions unchanged
Document the Herdr terminal stream UTF-8 decoding contract in docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. In docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md, section '## Herdr wire facts (v0.9.1, protocol 22)', extend the bullet beginning '- Terminal streams are NDJSON `terminal.frame` records' (or add a sibling bullet directly after it) with the PRD's text: bytes is base64 of UTF-8 terminal output; encoding 'ansi' names escape sequences, not a charset; herdr-stream.ts decodes with one streaming TextDecoder per stream so a split character decodes whole; a full frame starts a fresh decoder; an incremental frame that decodes to nothing emits no output frame; invalid bytes become U+FFFD; decoding as Latin-1 ('binary') was the PAN-4310 mojibake bug. Touch no other file.
